instrument_name: IL-700-T (R-12/25) Illinois Withholding Tax Tables, effective 2026-01-01 (full re-read)
article_or_section: General Information p.3 (How do I calculate); Automated payroll method p.4
figure_or_rule_carried: Rate 4.95% (.0495). Exemptions: Form IL-W-4 Line 1 allowances x 2,925 plus Line 2 allowances x 1,000 per year, divided by pay periods per year; withhold = .0495 x (wages - exemptions); add Line 3 additional amount. Booklet tables by period (daily, weekly, bi-weekly, semi-monthly, monthly) print cents; Line 2 allowance subtraction per period printed on each table (weekly 0.95, daily 0.14). Worked examples: 300 weekly with 2+1 allowances = 8.38; 800 weekly with 2+2 allowances: 7,850/52 = 150.96, 649.04 x .0495 = 32.13. No rounding rule stated (results shown in cents). No separate supplemental rate in the booklet; bonus is compensation (Pub 130). CORRECTS predecessor rows: 2,925 is the Line 1 allowance, Line 2 is 1,000.
